_comment: Index template for agent LLM call records. Apply BEFORE the first document.
Two settings here are single-node-specific and load-bearing:
number_of_replicas: 0  -- any replica on a 1-node cluster is unassignable,
which leaves every index YELLOW forever.
codec: best_compression -- LLM logs are text-heavy; this is a large win
for a small CPU cost at index time.
Field-explosion guard: 'messages' and 'tool_calls' are FLATTENED, not objects.
Dynamically mapping arbitrary tool-call JSON creates a new field per distinct
key, and the 1000-field limit then starts rejecting writes. Flattened keeps the
whole structure queryable as one field.
'prompt.text' and 'response.text' are analysed text so full-text search works
("every response mentioning lava"). 'messages' stays flattened alongside them
for exact structural queries. You want both -- they answer different questions.
THE GAME AGENT IS 'bot.*', NOT 'agent.*'. ECS reserves agent.* for the shipping
agent, and Filebeat injects agent.name/type/version into every event it sends.
Combined with dynamic:strict that collision rejects 100% of documents, silently,
with the only evidence being a 'events were dropped' line in the Filebeat log.
This cost a debugging cycle. Do not rename it back.
